title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. translated_title: SPROUT：预测基于目标导向的提示词效用以实现高效的文本到图像偏好微调
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型的偏好微调将大部分算力消耗在生成候选图像上，然而训练提示词通常以均匀随机的方式采样，导致算力被浪费在生成那些对模型对齐提供信号过少的图像上。为了最大限度地利用可用算力，我们研究了提示词选择问题，即在每次迭代中识别出对偏好微调最有用的提示词。我们将提示词选择分解为三个部分：效用分数、该效用分数的估计器以及批次选择。在此框架内，我们提出了基于预测目标导向效用的选择方法（SPROUT）。效用分数由一个纯文本模型对提示词池中的每个提示词（包括未见过的提示词）进行预测，并在每次迭代后基于迄今观察到的所有效用进行重新拟合。随后，一个随机化接受规则将这些预测转化为一个训练批次，因此除用于训练的图像外不会生成任何额外图像。对于直接组偏好优化……
tldr: 提出SPROUT方法，利用纯文本模型预测提示词的效用分数并通过随机化接受规则筛选训练批次，使文本到图像扩散模型的偏好微调无需额外生成图像即可选出最有用的提示词，从而大幅提升算力利用效率。
en_tdlr: SPROUT uses a text-only model to predict objective-grounded prompt utility and a randomized acceptance rule for batch selection, enabling efficient prompt selection for text-to-image preference tuning without generating any images beyond those used for training.
